title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 4: No Make-Up Test

scenes.say: Classroom. Battlefield tactics on the screen. Sergeant Mack walks the rows.
scenes.visual: soldiers in a training classroom with tactics slides on a screen, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Know the terrain. Know your brothers. Don't rely on luck. Rely on instinct.
scenes.visual: a sergeant walking between rows of desks, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Your life depends on how well you listen today.
scenes.visual: a recruit writing notes furiously in a notebook, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I used to zone out in school. But war ain't got no make-up test.
scenes.visual: an open notebook full of handwritten notes and diagrams, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Shooting range. Ali hits target after target. Dead aim.
scenes.visual: a target with tight grouped bullet holes at a shooting range, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Flores: Damn, Jersey. You got that assassin vibe. Ali: Just blockin' out the noise.
scenes.visual: soldiers on a firing line, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Doc: That's why you dangerous. Calm outside, chaos inside.
scenes.visual: soldiers laughing at a range, faces turned away, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Chow hall. Q tells stories about Detroit. Flores mimics her drill sergeant.
scenes.visual: a crowded army chow hall full of laughter and trays, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a soldier's tray and a smile in soft focus, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: In that mess hall, I found more family than I ever had back home.
scenes.visual: a long table of soldiers eating together, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Five. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: army mess hall trays stacked at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 4 of 25: No Make-Up Test. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
